subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me a 6-mark exam-style question on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a worked example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What is the magnitude of the column vector (3, 4)?
An exterior angle of a regular polygon is 40°. How many sides does it have?
Which column vector translates a shape 4 units left and 1 unit up?
questions.explain: Left is negative x and up is positive y, giving (-4, 1).

questions.q: A shape is translated by the column vector (6, 0). Which statement is true?
questions.explain: A positive x-component with zero y-component moves the shape 6 units right.

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 3. A side of length 5 cm becomes how long?
questions.explain: Lengths multiply by the scale factor: 5 × 3 = 15 cm.

questions.q: Under a rotation, one point of a shape does not move at all. What does this point represent?
questions.explain: A point that does not move is the centre (invariant point) of the rotation.

questions.q: Two angles are vertically opposite. One is 47°. What is the other?
questions.explain: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so it is 47°.

questions.q: A triangle is rotated 90° clockwise about the origin. The point (1, 0) maps to which point?
questions.explain: A 90° clockwise rotation about the origin sends (1, 0) to (0, -1).

questions.q: The bearing of B from A is 070°. What is the bearing of A from B?
What is the size of each exterior angle of a regular hexagon?
questions.explain: Exterior angles sum to 360°, so each is 360° ÷ 6 = 60°.

questions.q: The point (2, 7) is reflected in the y-axis. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in the y-axis negates the x-coordinate: (-2, 7).
